description: Lists the playlists of the calling account's notebook. Playlists are FLAT and allow multi-membership: `songIds` is the ORDERED list of song ids, and one song can appear in several playlists. Same cursor pagination and same updatedSince incremental filter as jj_list_songs. Consumes one unit of the daily read quota.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's `nextCursor`. Replay it verbatim; never build one.

limit.description: Page size, default 30, hard cap 100 (25 when fields="full").

updatedSince.description: ISO 8601 date. Returns only objects STRICTLY newer (updatedAt > updatedSince). Keep the largest updatedAt you received and pass it back next time for an incremental export.

name: jj_list_playlists
title: List my notebook playlists
